scenario: An independent recruiter opens Today after a meaningful synthetic candidate conversation, identifies the outcome needing attention, reviews exact evidence, and considers one safe next step without an external effect.
frozen_evidence: pnpm ios:check exit 65; Release build and 31 unit tests passed; one relationship-capture UI test failed and localhost sync was skipped

review_plan.reason: The artifact claims to guide a time-constrained recruiter from changed evidence to a useful next action.
The artifact binds sensitive evidence to identity and presents a relationship-state confirmation.
The release surface is a native iOS critical path with consequential feedback and recovery states.
The proposed follow-up and unresolved client dependency can affect candidate trust, time, and closure.
The frozen artifact contains no candidate assessment, quality, fit, personality, ranking, protected-trait, or acceptance-probability claim.

reviews.lens: time-constrained recruiter workflow value, state integrity, action usefulness, and operational fit

findings.observation: The visible loop ends at a view-local relationship label, not a canonical revision, owned Pursuit action, observed outcome, or Today readback.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-24-v1-baseline/recruiter-workflow-review.json; RelationshipArchiveSheets.swift uses local @State; pnpm ios:check exited 65.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter can lose a supposedly confirmed decision and still must reconstruct what to do, who owns it, and when it returns.
findings.recommendation: Apply a revision-checked canonical decision and stage one recruiter-owned action inside the correct Pursuit, then read both back into Today.
findings.verification: Confirm, dismiss, relaunch, and reopen the scenario; the same revision, evidence, Pursuit gap, action owner, timing, and outcome state remain visible without duplication.

strengths: The review orders exact evidence and provenance before the proposed state and does not execute an external effect.
missing_evidence: No passing capture-to-identity-to-canonical-state-to-Pursuit-action-to-outcome run or realistic recruiter field comparison exists.

reviews.lens: identity, provenance, canonical-state truthfulness, authorization, reversibility, and deletion

findings.observation: The review says Relationship state confirmed after changing only sheet-local @State, with no domain command, actor, timestamp, revision, durable receipt, or readback.
findings.user_impact: The app can mislead a recruiter about a consequential decision, lose it on dismissal, and leave no accountable correction trail.
findings.recommendation: Create an idempotent, revision-checked canonical command and show success only from a read-back receipt containing scope, prior and new revision, actor, time, and evidence references.
findings.verification: Dismiss and relaunch after confirmation; the canonical revision and receipt remain visible. Concurrent, duplicate, stale, and failed confirmations never show applied success.

strengths: The artifact explicitly keeps external execution separate from the internal review.
missing_evidence: Real privacy lifecycle, tenant isolation, external-effect reconciliation, and calibrated Agent evaluation remain unproven.
vetoes: The review presents an unverified relationship-state write as successful: tapping Confirm changes only view-local state, then renders Relationship state confirmed.

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, truthful feedback, and recovery

findings.observation: The primary confirmation immediately presents success from local view state; this path has no authoritative operation, reconciliation, conflict, retry, unknown, or recovery state.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-24-v1-baseline/mobile-ux-review.json; frozen source and screenshot; pnpm ios:check exit 65.
findings.user_impact: A user cannot distinguish applied work from a transient preview or safely recover from interruption and uncertainty.
findings.recommendation: Drive feedback from a typed operation state machine and canonical receipt, with pending, failed, stale, conflict, unknown-locked, reconciled, and applied states.
findings.verification: Execute the complete state matrix on small and current iPhones, including termination and relaunch; no false success, silent loss, or duplicate operation occurs.

strengths: The editorial Today surface is visually calm and keeps evidence close to the decision.
missing_evidence: No frozen direct interaction, VoiceOver, small-phone, AX5, localization, dark-mode, reduced-motion, latency, or complete recovery evidence exists for this path.
vetoes: The review presents an unverified relationship-state write as successful: tapping Confirm changes only view-local state, then renders Relationship state confirmed.

reviews.lens: candidate trust, communication, time respect, human ownership, and dignified closure

findings.observation: The artifact protects against accidental sending but contains no candidate-visible clarification, delay, correction, preference, withdrawal, rejection, or closure journey.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-24-v1-baseline/candidate-experience-review.json; the frozen screenshot is recruiter-only and external writes are intentionally unavailable.
findings.user_impact: The product cannot yet demonstrate that candidates are kept informed, can correct misunderstanding, or receive humane closure.
findings.recommendation: Add synthetic recruiter-reviewed message previews for clarification, delay, withdrawal, and closure, each with a human owner, time commitment, and easy correction or opt-out path.
findings.verification: Inspect exact candidate-visible previews and handoff receipts for all four variants; no send occurs without separate approval and authorized candidate feedback remains required for an experience claim.

strengths: The internal-only review and explicit no-external-change copy reduce accidental candidate harm.
missing_evidence: No candidate-facing artifact, recipient feedback, waiting-state ownership, opt-out, or respectful closure proof exists.

top_findings.reason: The critical path presents a transient view-state change as a completed relationship-state write.
top_findings.next_step: Implement a versioned, idempotent canonical decision operation and render success only from a verified readback receipt.
top_findings.verification: Applied, duplicate, stale, concurrent, failed, unknown, reconciled, dismissed, and relaunched cases all end in truthful deterministic states.

top_findings.reason: Today/People/Library and relationship review do not identify a Pursuit target, blocking gap, owned action, or observed outcome.
top_findings.next_step: Establish the Pursuit contract and make the same reviewed decision update one Pursuit gap and one internal action without an external effect.
top_findings.verification: A cold-launch recruiter can identify outcome, milestone, blocker, evidence freshness, owner, action, and resulting progress from Today through Pursuit readback.

top_findings.criterion: Complete mobile state and recovery model
top_findings.reason: The critical path has no truthful pending, failure, conflict, unknown, retry, reconciliation, interruption, or relaunch experience.
top_findings.next_step: Connect the iOS review to the typed operation state machine and implement the full critical state matrix before visual refinement.
top_findings.verification: Automated and direct Simulator runs on small/current devices show zero false success, silent loss, unsafe repeat, or inaccessible recovery.

agreements: All four reviewers found that the artifact does not prove the complete Pursuit-centered evidence-to-action-to-outcome loop.
Recruiter, safety, and mobile reviews agree that the displayed confirmation is not backed by durable canonical state.
The evidence-first ordering and separation from external execution are useful foundations but cannot rescue the false success state.
The frozen failed iOS check and missing field, accessibility, recovery, and recipient evidence prevent a 99-point claim.

adjudication.rationale: Active safety and mobile vetoes block release before any scoring discussion. The first implementation slice must establish truthful canonical state and Pursuit context; visual polish and candidate-facing proof follow on that governed foundation. The four scores remain attached to different rubrics and are not averaged.

next_tests.test: Canonical Pursuit review operation across applied, duplicate, stale, concurrent, failed, unknown, reconciled, dismissal, termination, and relaunch states.
next_tests.evidence_required: Contract tests, database revision/audit rows, API receipts, passing iOS unit/UI run, and direct Simulator readback tied to one frozen synthetic fixture.
next_tests.pass_condition: Every case ends deterministically with one canonical revision, scoped evidence lineage, truthful UI copy, and no false success or duplicate operation.

next_tests.test: Pursuit-centered cold-launch task from Today to reviewed evidence, owned internal action, and observed local outcome.
next_tests.evidence_required: Today/Pursuits/People build, Pursuit Detail state, action receipt, time/freshness labels, UI tests, and direct task recording.
next_tests.pass_condition: The user can state the outcome, deadline or milestone, blocker, evidence freshness, owner, next action, and result without reconstructing context elsewhere.

next_tests.test: Synthetic clarification, client-delay, withdrawal, and respectful-closure message previews without sending.
next_tests.evidence_required: Exact recipient-visible previews, ownership and response commitments, correction/opt-out paths, accessibility states, and human approval receipts.
next_tests.pass_condition: Each preview is specific, candid, easy to correct or decline, separately approved, and never sent by this V1 test.
